about:
# Time As Percentage

Have you ever wanted to know how far you're into a level (time wise)? Well, me neither!

"Time As Percentage" aims to fix that non-existent problem! Now when you play a level, it will display your attempt's playtime / the level's enire completion time.

## Credits
